# Milad Ajaz Bhat

> Milad Ajaz Bhat (m4milaad) is a software developer and machine learning engineer from Kashmir, India. He builds software, web apps and machine learning models, and studies computer science (B.Tech, CSE, expected July 2027) at the Central University of Kashmir. He is open to work.

## Selected work

- [CUK Acadex](https://github.com/m4milaad/schedule-savvy-schedules) (2025): campus software for searching course material, scheduling exams and collaborating across web and Android. React, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, pgvector, RAG, Kotlin.
- [KATHE English-to-Kashmiri Translation](https://github.com/m4milaad/bpccEngtoKash) (2026): English-to-Kashmiri machine translation fine-tuned from multilingual models (NLLB-200, IndicTrans2) with LoRA on limited data. Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers.
- [SentinelFlow](https://github.com/m4milaad/SentinelFlow) (2026): a Redis-backed service that manages API traffic and tracks rate-limit performance under load. Java, Spring Boot, Redis, Prometheus, Docker, Kubernetes.
- [BIS AI](https://github.com/m4milaad/bis-ai) (2026): a multilingual product safety app with image analysis and offline access. React, PWA, Supabase, Gemini API, RAG.
- [2AI Conference](https://github.com/m4milaad/2ai-Conference) (2026): registration, payments and media storage for the 2AI conference. React, Supabase, Edge Functions, Cloudflare R2.
- [repo-ready](https://github.com/m4milaad/repo-ready) (2026): a Python command-line tool that checks repositories and generates reports for continuous integration.
